verdict.rationale: Teller is an API-first product. Its documented public REST API covers balances, transactions, identity, payments and account details, with mTLS authentication, pagination, idempotent payment requests and a sandbox environment. A community user also reports building an export script against the 'super easy to use API'. missing for 10: a published machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all candidate paths returned 404) and an llms.txt or markdown docs index for agent consumption.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The account balances API provides your application with live, real-time account balances.
The transactions API exposes the ledger transactions of a financial account.
The Teller API uses mTLS to authenticate the API caller. Teller issues client certificates that you use to connect to the Teller API.
the transactions list endpoint supports pagination controls.
I built a little script to export my accounts to CSV/QIF. Super easy to use API!
